blocchi.regola: the macro reading is a composite of leading macro indicators; it is compared with its level 30 days earlier: higher by 0.5 or more is expanding, lower by 0.5 or more is contracting, in between is flat
blocchi.nota: the composite history starts on 2026-09-12: the comparison covers the 26 days available, not 30

dati.metodo: the regression line is fitted on all prices through the day shown and applied to past days too (a look back, not what was known then); each measure: today's value, percentile on its own history (one year and full), and expanding / contracting / flat over 30 days with the band written next to it; levels against the median of the 5 days around 30 days earlier, sums through 2026-10-06 against the 30 days before
dati.cancello_nota: gate result for the sentences: ok = at least one sentence passed; each sentence carries its own result; the values in tables and history are not certified one by one
